result.summary: The page overall looks well-structured with only a minor visual inconsistency found in icon coloring on cards.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card is white/outlined while the heart icon on the pizza card below is filled dark, creating inconsistent styling for the same UI element across similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon style (color, fill, outline) across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
